engine.es.js and index-B8WsUNf5.js are byte-identical copies of node_modules/thinking-orbs/dist/
(the framework-free `thinking-orbs/engine` export). Used by public/js/app/thinking-orb.js.
To update: copy the same two files from the new version's dist/ and rename this folder.
